answer: Bond per identity. Agent posts collateral before it can vote or earn, sized above what one fake identity could extract. Random peers audit its outputs. A proven cheat forfeits the full bond, split among the auditors who caught it. Sybils multiply the stake, not the payoff, so cloning stops paying. A plume of fresh accounts gets no shortcut: each must bond alone. Reputation cannot be bought in bulk. Honest agents on the knoll of good standing keep their stake and earn yield. Juniper-level trust comes only from time and clean audits.
